_note: No secrets here. key_file is relative to the machine's secrets folder ($JARVIS_SECRETS, D:\jarvis-secrets on Windows, ~/.jarvis/secrets on Linux). A provider stays enabled=false until its key file exists AND a live call has worked. paid must stay false. Lanes: local, private, public. Base URLs verified against provider docs on 2026-10-07 (groq, openrouter); the others are still null.

providers.name: dahl-deepseek
providers._note: OFF: measured 2026-10-10 its text replies loop ('pongpongpong response...' until max_tokens), wasting the token pool; tool calls were fine. Retest before enabling. Owner decision 2026-10-10: Dahl (FROMZERO OU, Estonia; terms allow agents and API automation) for the lab lane, one entry per model so a busy model (429 model_concurrency) falls back to the next and agents can switch_model. OpenAI-compatible API on the Gonka network: requests run on independent GPU operators who may see the content, so PUBLIC LANE ONLY, never private data. Prepaid promotional pool on the owner's one account (no card billing; never top up); the key holds an allocation from that pool, which caps a leak. HTTP 402 = allocation used up. Model IDs rotate: check GET /v1/models.

providers.name: puter
providers._note: Owner decision 2026-10-09: Puter for the lab lane (Kaggle parked). Cloud models (Puter, then OpenAI or Google): public lane only, never private data. The key is the owner's Puter account token (whole-account scope): keep it in secrets only. Free allowance is undocumented; cheap models only.
